# E6 — all six models on Thor's measured roofline (T006)

**Generated by `bench/make_e6_reports.py`.** One row per model × mode × part. Time = the T005 CUDA-event region median of the same configuration; FLOPs and DRAM bytes = ncu counters (T003-validated); floor from the analytic bytes and FLOPs at the measured ceilings; coverage = the share of the part's nsys kernel time joined to ncu. DRAM bytes are cold-L2 bytes (ncu flushes the caches before each replay): an upper bound for the in-sequence traffic. Per-model detail: `reports/E6_<model>_roofline.md`.
